mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which potentiates ACE inhibitor-induced hypotension and increases risk of acute kidney injury and hyperkalemia.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, potassium, and magnesium closely; maintain adequate hydration; consider alternative antifungal agents if possible; adjust enalapril dosing based on renal function.
